Becca (PM): Quick sync to finalize the design-partner pilot rules. Need sign-off on slot types, recruitment signals, feedback cadence, incentives, and replacement flow before I publish the playbook.

Jen (CS): Recruitment: require live integration + named POC. Score: usage 45, readiness 30, strategic fit 25. Ask candidate how many hours/week they can commit.

Omar (Eng): Ops limits: we can support up to 10 active slots if avg SE time <=2h/week. Propose caps: Deep=3h/wk, Standard=1h/2w. KV warm-cache: opt-in, single window 7-14d max, auto-teardown.

Ravi (Design): Feedback format: short structured form (3 questions) after milestones + optional 20m recorded session for Deep partners. First question: "Actionable within 2 sprints? (yes/no)"

Tess (Legal): Pilot addendum: telemetry consent + feedback IP license + rollback clause. Fast e-sign for SMBs; flagged regulated partners need extra review.

Becca (PM): Draft policy: slots=11 (5 Deep / 4 Standard / 2 Float). Incentives: Deep=$1k credit + exec sync, Standard=$300 credit. On-time bonus $200 for completing required feedback in first month.

Jen (CS): Missed-commit rule: miss 2 required milestones or 2 scheduled calls w/o reschedule -> probation (72h) -> release slot if no response. pilot-bot: send probation notice and manage waitlist invites (48h accept window).

pilot-bot: probation flow created: auto-send -> 72h response window -> if no action mark slot released -> invite top waitlist candidate with 48h accept window.

Omar (Eng): Monitoring: tag pilot traffic with pilot_id and partner_id, isolate quotas for Deep partners to avoid noisy neighbor. Debug bundles expire after 30d. Rollback playbook: if regression affects other customers, rollback within 24h and pause slot pending RCA.

Ravi (Design): Metrics: capture sentiment (-2..+2), feedback completion rate, response latency, and actionable item count. Show per-slot on dashboard.

Becca (PM): Activation gates per partner: smoke test pass, kickoff recorded, baseline survey returned, addendum signed if telemetry enabled. Program success: avg feedback >=6/10 and at least 3 actionable items surfaced in first 30 days.

Tess (Legal): Note: regulated (health/finance) partners require security contact and add ~7-14 days to onboarding. Flag in recruitment sheet.

Becca (PM): Great, Ill consolidate into a one-pager and recruitment CSV and publish 09:00 PT tomorrow. Quick thumbs?

Omar (Eng): :thumbsup:
Jen (CS): :thumbsup:
Ravi (Design): :thumbsup:
Tess (Legal): :thumbsup:

Becca (PM): thanks all. I'll feed pilot-bot the invite list and post the playbook.
